doc.citation: Rubinstein, C. V. and Vajda, V. 2023. Middle–Late Ordovician organic-walled phytoplankton from Sweden: diversity and early radiation. Estonian Journal of Earth Sciences, 72(1), 158.
doc.comment: The supplied text is a one-page abstract without tables or figure captions. It reports cryptospores and trilete spores collectively from 23 samples, without taxonomic identifications or sample-level distributions. Crossref verification was unavailable.

items.locality: vicinity of Motala, east of Lake Vättern in south central Sweden
items.formation: Furudal Limestone; Dalby Limestone; Kinnekulle K-bentonite; Skagen Limestone
items.age_as_reported: late Darriwilian (Stage slice Dw3)–early Katian (Stage slice Ka1)
items.age_basis_detail: Conodonts and 206Pb/238U dating of volcanic ash deposits.
items.setting_as_reported: marine marly carbonates deposited relatively close to land
items.notes: The main focus is marine organic-walled phytoplankton, principally acritarchs. Sparse terrestrial palynomorphs comprise cryptospores and trilete spores. The reported age range describes the sampled succession; individual spore-bearing levels and the distribution of each spore group are unspecified. Acritarch assemblages A, B and C cannot be treated as separate spore assemblages from this account. Reworking is not addressed.
